core_obligations: The maps e maps-to alpha_i^e from the nonnegative integers (a monoid under addition) to L are monoid homomorphisms, and they are pairwise distinct because alpha_i differs from alpha_j already at e = 1

Linear independence of these characters says that for coefficients not all zero some exponent gives a nonzero combination; applying it to the all-ones coefficients, the power sums cannot all vanish, so some e >= 0 has sum alpha_i^e nonzero
